_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/casting/test_suspends_itself.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_suspends_itself` gains 2 life so the test can see the effects ran each time it resolves; `t_suspends_itself_kill` has a target, so the test can make it fizzle.

cards.name: Test Suspends Itself
cards.oracle_text: You gain 2 life. Exile Test Suspends Itself with two time counters on it.

cards.name: Test Suspends Itself Kill
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. Exile Test Suspends Itself Kill with two time counters on it.
